note: THE DOCUMENT'S FIRST NAMED INEFFICIENCY, verbatim: 'encoding the length of two (2), a value less than 128, with long form uses two bytes (0x8102) instead of the short form one-byte (0x02) length'. Refused because ST 0107.3-05 requires 'the fewest possible bytes' — a live numbered requirement, unlike the deprecated ST 0601.8-07 it replaced.
